Short title

THE MUSSALMAN WAKF VALIDATING
THE MUSSALMAN WAKF VALIDATING
ACT, 1930.
ACT No. XXXII of 1930
(For
Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gazette of India, 1929, Pt. V, p. 240 ;
for Report of Select Committee, see ibid., 1930, Pt. V, p. 107.)
[25th
July, 1930]
An Act to give retrospective effect to the Mussalman
Wakf Valida ting Act, 1913.
WHEREAS the
Mussalman Wakf Validating Act, 1913, does not apply to wakfs created before its
enactment ;
AND WHEREAS it
is expedient to validate such wakfs without infringing any rights contrary
thereto which may have already accrued or been acquired ; It is hereby enacted
as follows :‑
1. Short title----This Act
may be called the Mussalman Wakf Validating Act, 1930.

Act VI of 1913 to apply retrospectively

THE MUSSALMAN WAKF VALIDATING
THE MUSSALMAN WAKF VALIDATING
ACT, 1930.
ACT No. XXXII of 1930
(For
Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gazette of India, 1929, Pt. V, p. 240 ;
for Report of Select Committee, see ibid., 1930, Pt. V, p. 107.)
[25th
July, 1930]
An Act to give retrospective effect to the Mussalman
Wakf Valida ting Act, 1913.
WHEREAS the
Mussalman Wakf Validating Act, 1913, does not apply to wakfs created before its
enactment ;
AND WHEREAS it
is expedient to validate such wakfs without infringing any rights contrary
thereto which may have already accrued or been acquired ; It is hereby enacted
as follows :‑
2. Act VI of 1913 to apply retrospectively------The Mussalman Wakf Validating Act, 1913, shall be deemed to apply to
wakfs created before its commencement: VI of
1913.
Provided that
nothing herein contained shall be deemed in any way to affect any right, title,
obligation or liability already acquired, accrued or incurred before the
commencement of this Act.
